CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.refuse_pending_provider_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT private.account_is_active((to_jsonb(new)->>TG_ARGV[0])::uuid) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'account_deactivated' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN new;
END $function$
